name: Ritee Rouf
summary: Sr. Product Marketing Executive and AI GTM Leader scaling growth across Enterprise SaaS, global infrastructure, healthcare, and developer platforms at Google, VMware, Oracle, and Omnicell. Expert at shaping category narratives and translating complex technologies into compelling business stories that accelerate adoption. A hands-on people leader and "0-to-1" builder with proven experience driving measurable growth: 35% pipeline expansion, 3x revenue increase, and 7x SQL growth. Adept at aligning cross-functional stakeholders to execute strategic wins.

key_achievements.label: AI GTM Leadership (LatticeFlow)
key_achievements.text: Built a full stack marketing function from the ground up, achieving 35% pipeline growth and 50% organic search lift within 6 months; established global thought leadership by orchestrating an AI Safety panel with global AI leaders at the World Economic Forum (Davos).

key_achievements.label: Category Creation & Sales Acceleration
key_achievements.text: Launched the first partner ecosystem ($4M pipeline) and architected sales playbook driving 7x SQL increase and 30% faster deal cycles. Instrumental in the category creation of "Data Catalog" at Alation while scaling from Series B-C.

key_achievements.label: Enterprise Launch + Revenue Impact
key_achievements.text: Drove $45M expansion revenue at Omnicell via pre-configured medication dispensing cabinets (separate from XaaS repositioning); orchestrated the first global launch of vSphere Integrated Containers reaching 400+ enterprise customers (VMworld keynote, 20K attendees).
